I changed `src/invoice.py` so `tax()` rounds half up, as FIN-12 requires. I couldn't run the tests, so CI still needs to confirm the fix.

- **Cause:** `tax()` used `math.floor`, which truncates. That gave 10.12 where 10.125 should round up to 10.13.
- **Fix:** It now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The inputs go through `str()` first, so float error doesn't affect the exact half-cent cases. I left the test untouched.
- **Impact:** Every invoice tax amount now rounds half up instead of truncating. Some live amounts will come out up to one cent higher than before. Finance may want to know before the 3:00 release.
